summary: Visual, example-driven guide to Claude Code with copy-paste templates for commands, memory, skills, hooks, subagents and MCP.

heroCommands.comment: Get the guide and copy your first command
heroCommands.command:
git clone https://github.com/luongnv89/claude-howto.git
cd claude-howto
mkdir -p /path/to/your-project/.claude/commands
cp 01-slash-commands/optimize.md /path/to/your-project/.claude/commands/

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Claude How To is a visual guide to Claude Code that takes you from typing claude to orchestrating agents. It has tutorials, a guided learning path and copy-paste templates for slash commands, project memory, skills, hooks, subagents, MCP servers and plugins.
sixtySeconds.problem: Claude Code has many features and the docs alone don't show how to set them up in a real project. This guide gives ready-made templates you copy into your project, organised by level.
whoFor: Developers who want templates, not theory
Teams setting up shared Claude Code config
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a structured, hands-on path with templates you can use in minutes, available in several languages.

overview: Start in 15 minutes: clone the guide, copy a slash command into your project's .claude/commands folder and try it in Claude Code. Then add project memory with a CLAUDE.md template and install a skill into ~/.claude/skills.

A one-hour essential setup covers slash commands, project memory and a skill; the weekend goal adds hooks, subagents, MCP and plugins. A feature catalog and a level finder help you choose where to start.
The README recommends Claude Code's native installer. The guide is MIT licensed.
